doc.title: Dick Griffin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 12, 2024

title: Apollo Theater house band and Maurice King
summary: Griffin explains playing different acts each week at the Apollo and praises Maurice King's arrangements.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: They would have horn parts for — someone would write the arrangements and you’d come in and be expected to read them, correct?

Oh yeah. That was in the Apollo Theater every week different people would come in. And that way when I played with Gladys Knight and the Pips and there was an arranger called Maurice King. Maurice King influenced Thad Jones and some of the writers out of Detroit. But his arrangements were off the hook to the day, he was a very great arranger. Maurice King.
